title: How Do Peer Awards Motivate Creative Content? Experimental Evidence from Reddit
authors: Gordon Burtch; Qinglai He; Yili Hong; Dokyun Lee
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment (905 treated users given Reddit Gold, 905 controls). All main-text tables (Tables 4-9) are cross-sectional user-level comparisons of 2-week post-assignment outcomes on the treatment dummy (reg/logit/poisson/tobit/biprobit/bivcnto/ranksum), with no panel and no unit or time fixed effects. The only panel regression (Appendix Table B1, DD_weekly.dta) is appendix-only and adds relweek main effects for all users (event time defined for controls from their own entry date), an extra additive FE set under 5b; col 2 likewise.
design_notes: 2_week_posts.dta: one row per user (1,810), outcomes measured over the two weeks after the user's own experiment entry date (treat_dt). DD_weekly.dta: user x calendar-week panel, 28,960 rows, relweek 0-16 relative to each user's entry with week 8 (treatment week) dropped; Appendix B1: reghdfe posted_ss ib7.relweek##treated i.actual_week, absorb(user_id) and reghdfe n_posts_ss ib7.relweek##treated, absorb(user_id actual_week). Treated users switch on at staggered weeks, but the specification is a pooled-event-time comparison with relweek main effects, appendix only.
estimators_reported: appendix: event-time x treated with user and week FE plus event-time main effects
main_or_robustness: neither (RCT cross-section; panel DiD appendix only)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Users enter the experiment on different dates over two months, but main-text analyses are cross-sectional.
excluded_specs_summary: Tables 4-9: cross-sectional regressions of outcomes on treated (no panel, no FE; several nonlinear). Appendix Table B1 (DD_weekly.dta, codes.do last two lines): event study with relweek main effects for all users (5b: extra additive FE) and appendix-only.
data_provenance_note: Experimental data shipped in full (1,810 users).
screener_notes: Not a staggered-adoption DiD paper; the experiment is analysed as a cross-section.
